value: Treasury Announces Increased Sizes of Nominal Long-End Liquidity Support Buybacks Beginning September 9

detail: Exact quoted text: "The current maximum size of $2 billion per operation will be at least $4 billion per operation.'' Not a per-month figure.

Exact quoted text: "increasing...the size of liquidity support buyback operations for longer-dated nominal coupon securities (the 10-year to 20-year sector and the 20-year to 30-year sector).'' Cash Management buybacks (separate bucket, 1Mo-2Y maturities) are not mentioned in this announcement and are confirmed unaffected -- see below.
10Y-20Y and 20Y-30Y nominal-coupon liquidity-support buckets only; confirmed via actual operation results before the change
As stated in the announcement; actual first post-change operation (see below) was capped even higher, at $6bn
"This change is effective September 9, 2026 and will be in effect for the remainder of this refunding quarter (through November 4, 2026).''
Treasury said it would provide more information about future buyback sizes at this Quarterly Refunding

fact: Cash Management operation on the effective date (unaffected control check)
detail: 1Mo to 2Y bucket, Total Par Amount Offered $28,027,000,000, Total Par Amount Accepted $12,500,000,000, Maximum Par Amount to be Redeemed $12,500,000,000 -- this operation's cap is unchanged from the prior Cash Management operation on 2026-09-03 (also $12.5bn), confirming the Aug 19 change did not touch the Cash Management bucket

fact: First expanded (Liquidity Support, 10Y-20Y/20Y-30Y) operation on or after 9 Sep 2026 -- Operation Date
detail: First Liquidity Support operation in the two long-end buckets named in the announcement, occurring on or after the 9 Sep 2026 effective date. Maturity date range of eligible securities: 02/15/2037-08/15/2046 (10Y to 20Y nominal-coupon bucket).

fact: First expanded operation -- Maximum Par Amount to be Redeemed (operation cap actually set)
detail: Above both the old $2bn cap and the announced "at least $4bn'' floor

fact: First expanded operation -- Total Par Amount OFFERED
detail: Submitted by primary dealers/eligible participants across 40 eligible issues

fact: First expanded operation -- Total Par Amount ACCEPTED
detail: Accepted across 23 of the 40 eligible issues; settlement date 2026-09-11

fact: Data source used to identify/cross-check the operation record
detail: Public JSON feed (https://api.fiscal.treasury.gov/ap/exp/v1/marketable-securities/buybacks) that treasurydirect.gov's own results page loads client-side; used only to locate the correct operation date, then independently verified word-for-word against the official Treasury results PDF cited above.
